assessment.description: Prepare the teaching dataset for supervised learning and report the choices made, with their consequences for what can be concluded.
assessment.title: Data Preparation Report

criteria.description: Does the student explain how preparation choices change what the model can learn, rather than only listing the steps taken?

levels.description: Consequences of each choice are argued and evidenced.
levels.label: strong

levels.description: Choices described, consequences only partly explored.
levels.label: adequate

criteria.title: Quality of data reasoning

levels.description: Pipeline is reproducible and free of leakage.
levels.label: strong

levels.description: Pipeline runs but contains a minor leakage risk.
levels.label: adequate

levels.description: Pipeline does not reproduce or leaks test data.
levels.label: weak

measures_outcome.title: Prepare and reason about data for learning

outcomes.description: The student can inspect, clean and split a dataset, and can explain how preparation choices affect what a model can learn.
